title: Container Bookings: Applying Payments to a Booking
content:
Money remitted against Container Bookings charges is applied booking by booking. This page states how a remittance is entered.

## Policy clause

A remittance is applied to a single booking. It is entered with the remittance reference exactly as the customer quotes it and with the amount the customer actually remitted. The amount applied cannot be greater than the booking's outstanding charges at the moment of application; whatever exceeds them is returned by the finance department and is not entered on the booking. The same remittance reference can be entered only once on a given booking, as the charge history shows.

Under prepaid terms the shipper settles freight on the booking ahead of the release of the transport document under the documentation rules. Under collect terms the consignee settles it at destination, and that payment too is applied to the same booking. The desk never spreads a payment across several bookings; a single remittance meant to cover several bookings is divided by the finance department and lies outside the desk's handling.

## The amount applied

The amount applied to the booking is the lower of the remitted amount and the booking's outstanding charges.

| Remitted | Outstanding on the booking | Applied |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00 | 800.00 | 500.00 |
| 800.00 | 800.00 | 800.00 |
| 950.00 | 800.00 | 800.00; the 150.00 excess is returned by finance |

The figures in the table are hypothetical.

## Basis Q&A

**The customer quotes a reference already entered on this booking. Can it be entered again?** No; a reference is recorded once per booking.

**Must the reference be tidied up before entry?** No; it is entered exactly as quoted.
